# Ops Enablement Lead Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills

## Overview

Use when enabling production operations including observability setup, SRE practices, runbook creation, and on-call configuration for new projects.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [ops-enablement-lead-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
ops-enablement-lead-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@ops-enablement-lead` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze business processes and identify improvement opportunities
- Apply domain best practices and industry-standard frameworks
- Assess current state against maturity models and benchmarks
- Generate findings with severity classification and remediation guidance

## Industry Standards Applied

- **IEEE 730**: Software quality assurance processes and standards
- **ISO 25010**: Software quality model: functional suitability, reliability, maintainability
